note.question: How do project supply chains shape incentive alignment and coordination?
note.overview: The model considers a project supply chain where a manufacturer carries out a sequence of tasks, and each task requires certain key materials from a supplier. Since a fixed-price contract cannot attain channel coordination, we focus on time-based incentive contracts. The paper's proposed contract requires optimization of the material delivery schedule as well as the fraction and the timing of a delayed payment to each supplier.
